working_definition: Female germline cells (nurse cells and oocyte) of egg chambers from stage 4 onward in the adult ovary (Li et al. 2022, Manual Annotation; broad class female germline cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that develops into or is itself an egg.

justification: Grouped stage-bounded call spanning nurse cells and oocyte; the most specific common parent is female germline cell.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: One of a group of 15 germ cells that lie anterior to the oocyte within the egg chamber.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only part of the group.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Female germline cell that develops from one of the 16 cyst cells and matures in an egg chamber.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only part of the group.

recommendation: Broad match to female germline cell.
